title: In the Classroom
description: Three short recordings about things and people in a classroom.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Finding a pencil
parts.intro: You will hear Linh and Sam in the classroom.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Sam, where is my pencil?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Is it on your desk?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No, it is not. I have a pen and a ruler.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Look! It is under your chair.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Thank you, Sam! It is yellow.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Your desk is very messy, Linh.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I know! I will clean it after school.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I am at school every day. I like my friends here.

parts.title: Part 2 · The teacher
parts.intro: You will hear Miss Rose talking to her class.

script.speaker: Miss Rose
script.text: Good morning, class! Please open your books.

script.speaker: Miss Rose
script.text: Today we have three new pictures on the wall.

script.speaker: Miss Rose
script.text: Look at the board. I can see a big sun and a little cat.

script.speaker: Miss Rose
script.text: Please sit down and be quiet. We start now.

script.speaker: Miss Rose
script.text: I am happy with this class. You are all very good.

script.speaker: Miss Rose
script.text: Remember to put your name on your work. That is important.

parts.title: Part 3 · Before lunch
parts.intro: You will hear Sam and Linh before lunch.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I am hungry. Is it lunch time?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Not yet. We have art first.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Great! I love art. Do you have crayons?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, I have ten. Do you want a red one?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Yes, please!

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: We can draw a big picture together.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: That is a good idea. Let us start after lunch.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Thank you, Linh. You are a very kind friend.

questions.explanation: Sam says it is under her chair, not on the desk.

questions.text: Is Linh happy at the end?
questions.explanation: She finds her pencil and says thank you.
Miss Rose says, "Please open your books."

questions.text: How many new pictures are on the wall?
What can Miss Rose see on the board?
questions.explanation: She sees a big sun and a little cat.

evidence.quote: a big sun and a little cat

questions.text: What do the children have first?
questions.explanation: Linh says they have art first, not lunch yet.
Linh offers a red crayon and Sam says yes.

evidence.quote: Do you want a red one?
